name: Mafia
author: EVILF
description: Fall between the platforms right after entering the ship portal at 19% and then stay a bit under the second platform (the one that the cube portal is on top of). Hold under the first block at 20% and then keep holding to make it back into the level's gameplay just as the ship. Navigate through the following gameplay until 29% where you can hold above the level. Stay above the level's gameplay until the end from there (you can also fall to the floor later in the level).
